overview.description: The YieldMax MSFT Option Income Strategy ETF (MSFO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to provide current income and capped gains on the Microsoft stock (MSFT) through a synthetic covered call strategy, collateralized by cash and US Treasurys. The actively managed fund uses both standardized exchange-traded and FLEX options. MSFO was launched on Aug 24, 2023 and is issued by YieldMax.
